Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and mild lymphopenia. There is elevated D-dimer, ferritin, LDH, CRP, INR, total bilirubin, and basophils, suggesting systemic inflammation, possible coagulopathy, and mild liver dysfunction. Cardiac and renal markers are within normal limits. Findings are consistent with acute systemic illness, possibly infection or inflammatory process, with risk for hypoxic and thrombotic complications. Clinical correlation is advised.
